description: Figure 3 illustrates inter-annotator agreement (measured by Fleiss’ Kappa) in relation to two sample-level ambiguity measures, shown as two separate vertical bar charts placed side by side. In both panels, the horizontal axis contains ambiguity categories and the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss’ Kappa” on a linear scale from 0 to 1 (with ticks shown at regular intervals), while the bars are solid blue with numeric values printed above each bar. The left panel is labeled “Ambiguity Std” on the x-axis and shows four categories ordered left to right as 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, with corresponding Fleiss’ Kappa values of approximately 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24. The right panel is labeled “Max Ambiguity” on the x-axis and shows three categories ordered left to right as 1, 2, and 3, with corresponding Fleiss’ Kappa values of approximately 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23. No legend is present, the bars are not stacked or grouped within each category beyond the two-panel layout, and there are no additional visual emphasis elements beyond the value annotations above the bars.
